build_VAE_model: build a VAE model with pixel encoder and decoder for observation reconstruction
run_VAE_train: run the VAE train method to compute BCE and KLD loss on observation batches
create_dmc2gym_environment: create a DM Control Gym environment with pixel observations and frame stacking
train_VAE_embeddings: train a VAE over 100 epochs using Adam optimizer and save latent embeddings
extract_VAE_encoder_output: extract encoder latent embeddings from a dataset and save to a PyTorch file
